author: Iron
body:
To: Seniors and Admins

Questions: Do the seniors plan on addressing ways to improve the staff team? Has any progress been made to establish transparency and to [admins] you two, do you discuss your ideas with moderators? Also, do the seniors have plans for any new iterations of the staff apppication system.

These are all legitimate questions, I would like them answered not archived. Its up to you guys to try and improve transparency, I want to see that that kind of progress is being made. Hence, I kindly ask you to respect my questions..

title: General Question the Second

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Do the seniors plan on addressing ways to improve the staff team

We've already had plenty of meetings discussing this. We have also been communicating with the staff team in fixing these issues and improving the team. We will hopefully be improving these soon. 

Also, do the seniors have plans for any new iterations of the staff apppication system.

We haven't really discussed staff apps but from my knowledge, they should be in 1-2 months (not confirmed but from past staff all lengths). I'll bring up staff applications in a future senior staff meeting.


I will keep this open for an admin. If you have any other questions, find me on ts or pm me on skype.

replies.body:
I can confirm what Seth is saying.

We have a lot of plans going to help improve our staff team as a whole, and more specifically our transparency. We do not have any new plans for staff application system items.
